name: io.github.oguzhanpisgin/mssql-readonly-mcp
title: mssql-readonly-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for on-premises SQL Server: one plain SELECT, startup login check, audit log.

environmentVariables.name: MSSQL_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: SQL Server connection string. Use a login that passes check-login (see the README, "Create and check the read-only login"). The server adds ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly and Application Name=mssql-readonly-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: MSSQL_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the audit file, created with its folder if missing. One server process writes a file at a time; on Windows a second process on the same path writes a sibling file (docs/audit-log.md).
